### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **16** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c110853e59ef75b9a137178aefd1a9bd495fe2e7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `eac89371577a03e1713d2f6188799d5282e1f9bf` — the merge of head `9c2faf5ecd7bd84912a35d4476c71f2e5ccb5da5` into base `c110853e59ef75b9a137178aefd1a9bd495fe2e7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin eac89371577a03e1713d2f6188799d5282e1f9bf && git checkout eac89371577a03e1713d2f6188799d5282e1f9bf
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c110853e59ef75b9a137178aefd1a9bd495fe2e7 9c2faf5ecd7bd84912a35d4476c71f2e5ccb5da5 && git checkout -B drift-repro c110853e59ef75b9a137178aefd1a9bd495fe2e7 && git merge --no-ff 9c2faf5ecd7bd84912a35d4476c71f2e5ccb5da5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c110853e59ef75b9a137178aefd1a9bd495fe2e7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

Contract review of #32493 · 2026-11-12T01:27Z (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER sub-agent run by the seat, adopted by the seat)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `48eeeeac8e10dc5111d759adc6266a7ed1785674`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts, packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts + packages/metadata/src/loaders/memory-loader.ts, packages/metadata/src/loaders/loader-interface.ts, packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts, packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts (the artifact door), packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts, and the six removal callers: packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-plugin.ts, packages/runtime/src/declared-datasources.ts, packages/runtime/src/code-datasource-names.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.ts (all read, never reviewed). Prose face not reviewed: .changeset/32353-door-copy-removed-every-type.md.

Check-runs on this head (the PR is a draft): 18 concluded `success`, among them Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · debt ledger, and the Dogfood Regression Gate aggregate (its 3 shards read `skipped`). NOT concluded at read time (`in_progress`): Build Core, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Live E2E UI. 16 are `skipped`, including Queue verdict and Dogfood Verify CLI. No failure on the head. The package's own tests have no CI verdict yet, so this PASS is the contract verdict only and the queue waits for Test Core and Type Check · workspace to conclude green.

### ① Derived judgments

- **What the removal door removes: right.** `isRemovalTarget` has one caller (`unregisterAt`, line 1882), which `unregister`, `unregisterPackage` and `bulkUnregister` all reach. Before: writable `datasource:` loaders for every type, plus a `memory:` loader with `delete` for the 5 slotted types only (`api, agent, skill, action, permission`). After: the same, with the `memory:` arm open to every type.
- **Slotted half unchanged: right.** The condition was already true for those types, and `MemoryLoader.delete` keeps its `(package, name)` branch.
- **Non-slotted delete is by name: right.** `storeRemovalKeys` returns no `packageId` for a type outside the set, so `deleteMetaItemFromLoader` calls `delete(type, name)` and `MemoryLoader.delete` runs `typeStore.delete(name)`. A `packageId` option is ignored the same way in the registry and in the loader, so the two stores cannot disagree.
- **Other loaders untouched: right.** `file:`, `http:`, `s3:`, a read-only `datasource:` loader and a `memory:` loader without `delete` are still skipped. The only `memory:` loader in `packages/` is `MemoryLoader`, built only by the artifact door (`plugin.ts:1406`).
- **Public surface: right.** No exported signature moves; `isRemovalTarget` is module-private and `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` is still imported and used.
- **Census of 6 callers: complete.** A grep of `packages/`, `apps/` and `examples/` at the head finds exactly the six, with the argument shapes the PR states.
- **Pins: right, one label off.** Six shapes × {door item gone live and on an empty-registry peer; customization over it gone; CONTROL}. The kept name survives live and on the peer, and a re-register serves again on the live manager. The flipped residue pin now asserts rows, `loadManyKeyed`, `get`, `exists` and `list` empty. Shape 5's label is the nit in ④.

### ② Semver level

Matches the ruling and what the diff publishes.
- `@objectstack/metadata` `patch` with a `!` title and the BREAKING banner is AGENTS.md's level for a non-protocol breaking change.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset; nothing an author writes moves.
- The ADR-0087 marker is present (`not-required`).
- `Skills-docs: none` holds: `metadata-service.mdx` line 66 only names `MemoryLoader` as the hydrating door.
- The three moved answers are declared FROM → TO: reads after a removal, Q1 A (no fallback to the door body), and a host's own `MemoryLoader`.
- The "Unchanged" paragraph states the per-node reach truthfully.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- **Out-of-scope finding, "carrier: none · noted, not filed": not accepted as carrier-less.** The dev names the stale `assertWritableLoaderContract` header. It sits in a floor file, inside the claimed file surface `packages/metadata/src/**`, and has a published twin. See the should-fix in ④.
- Deviation, `main` moved to `e765a092` without a second merge: answered. The merge base is `f0f729e7`, and `main` since then touches none of the diff files, the loaders or `package-slotted-store.ts`.
- Deviation, attribution link is the card thread's: accepted, no contract effect.
- Deviation, no assignee or review request: accepted; the seat's to write.
- **Escalated to the seat:** the peer half. A cluster peer drops only its registry entry (`invalidateForForeignWrite`), so its door copy keeps answering. Before this PR every node agreed (wrongly) for a non-slotted type; now the acting node answers nothing and a peer answers the door body. The changeset declares it, and no first-party caller reaches a door copy today. The PR says it is "recorded in #32347"; I could not confirm a card carries it from the inputs allowed. Name the carrier or file one.

### ④ Design judgment

**The narrowing makes the spec's own removal real; it takes no declared capability away.**
- The published contract says only "Unregister/remove a metadata item by type and name" (`metadata-service.ts`, `unregister`).
- The same contract states that this service does no overlay merging, and that its overlay members were removed under ADR-0049. The layered read that ships is the protocol's `getMetaItemLayered`.
- So "a removal falls back to the package body" was never declared on this surface; it was residue. Q1 A holds against the spec.
- For a type outside the set the name is the whole identity, so "remove the item" and "remove every copy under the name" are the same statement.

Break attempts, none of which holds:
- **A non-memory loader's item removed wrongly:** no. The `datasource:` arm is unchanged and the other protocols never pass.
- **A package-shipped item deleted through a door:** not reachable first-party.
  - `/meta` DELETE never calls `unregister`.
  - The datasource follower returns early for a code-origin name. `AppPlugin` contributes the artifact's datasource names in `init()`, and it is the declared pair of the door.
  - The admin delete goes through `removeDatasource`; its refusal of a non-runtime origin is the PR's claim, which I did not read.
  - objectql removes only a tenant-authored copy, and only when the engine registry serves nothing under the name.
  - The security echo is registered only when the service serves no declaration, and only echoes are dropped.
  - Install-local removes a copy stamped with the uninstalled package, which is the fix.
- **Customization over a removed item:** gone with it, as ruled, pinned for all six shapes. Protocol-level reset to baseline is untouched.
- **Re-register:** serves again; nothing is lost that `register` ever wrote. The door's copy returns on reload or restart: `_parseAndRegisterArtifact` builds a fresh `MemoryLoader` and `registerLoader` replaces the old one under the same name.
- **`unregisterPackage(A)` over a name whose door copy is stamped for package B:** it now deletes B's door copy by name. It needs two packages holding one non-slotted name, which install refuses, and the verb has no first-party caller. Observation only, covered by the changeset's first line.

Findings:
- **should-fix: two contract sentences now say the opposite of the code.**
  - `packages/metadata/src/loaders/loader-interface.ts:232-234`, the jsdoc of the exported `MetadataLoader.delete`: `memory:` loaders "are not gated: `MetadataManager` never writes to them at runtime, so it never has a deletion of its own to take back".
  - The `assertWritableLoaderContract` header in `metadata-manager.ts`: "both loops filter on `datasource:` too".
  - The first ships in the package's `.d.ts`. It contradicts moved answer 3 in the same release, for exactly the reader that answer addresses: a host with its own `memory:` loader.
  - Fix: reword both to say `unregister` also deletes from a `memory:` loader that implements `delete`, for every type. Comment-only, inside the claimed surface. It earns a delta review.
- **nit:** shape 5 is labelled "plugin-security dropEcho, naming the slot's package" but pins `{ packageId, notify: false }`, which is the stale-slot drop. `dropEcho` itself sends `{ packageId }` alone. No coverage gap: both options are inert for a type outside the set.
- **nit:** caller comments in `security-catalog-echo.ts`, `objectql/src/plugin.ts` and `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` still say `unregister` "also deletes through its writable `datasource:` loaders". True but now incomplete; outside this PR's file surface.

No must-fix.

## Contract review

### ① Derived judgments

Delta only; carries 6811661267 for the rest.

- **No runtime code moves: confirmed.** The two `src` hunks sit wholly inside jsdoc blocks: the `MetadataLoader.delete` jsdoc and the `assertWritableLoaderContract` header. The test hunk changes one header comment and the `SHAPES` table. The earlier PASS on behaviour carries.
- **`loader-interface.ts` jsdoc now agrees with the code, sentence by sentence.**
  - "`unregister()` also deletes from a `memory:` loader that implements `delete()` … for every type": this is `isRemovalTarget`'s second line (`protocol === 'memory:' && typeof loader.delete === 'function'`), with no type test. `unregisterAt` is its only caller.
  - "a `memory:` loader without `delete()` is skipped": same line.
  - "`file:`, `http:` and `s3:` loaders are never deleted from": `isRemovalTarget` returns false for them, and `deleteMetaItemFromLoader` is the only loader-delete site in the manager.
  - "so that a removed item stops answering": `MemoryLoader.delete` runs `typeStore.delete(name)` for a non-slotted type, and deletes by `(package, name)` keys for a slotted one.
- **`assertWritableLoaderContract` header now agrees.**
  - "`register()`'s loop filters on `datasource:`": line 940.
  - "`unregister()` also deletes from a `memory:` loader that implements `delete()`, for every type": as above; the `{@link isRemovalTarget}` target exists.
  - "A `datasource:` loader with `capabilities.write: false` is untouched by both paths": false on the register filter and on `isRemovalTarget`'s first line.
  - The gate itself is unchanged (`datasource:` + `write: true` only), so "not gated" still holds for the other protocols.
- **Shape labels match what each case passes.**
  - Shape 5 `{ packageId: P }` is `dropEcho`: it calls `unregisterEchoSlot(metadata, type, name, slot)` with `silent` defaulting to false, so it sends `{ packageId }` when the slot has one, and the bare call when it has none (shape 4).
  - Shape 6 `{ packageId: P, notify: false }` is the stale-slot drop (line 350): `silent = true`, reached only under `slot.packageId !== undefined`, so it always sends both keys.
- **Census claim still right.** Six callers, unchanged. The table is now 7 rows (6 call shapes + CONTROL), and the test header and PR body both say so. The PR body's "14 (7 shapes)" ablation count is arithmetic from the table, not a run I can see.

### ② Semver level

Delta only; carries 6811661267. Comment and test changes move no level. The published `.d.ts` jsdoc now matches moved answer 3 of the changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

Delta only; carries 6811661267.
- The out-of-scope finding the earlier review refused as carrier-less (the stale header) is fixed in this delta.
- The peer-half carrier question stays with the seat; this delta does not touch it.

### ④ Design judgment

Delta only; carries 6811661267 for the narrowing itself. Both findings of that review are answered.

- **should-fix (6811661267): closed.** Both sentences now state what `isRemovalTarget`, `unregisterAt` and `MemoryLoader.delete` do.
- **nit (6811661267, shape 5 label): closed.** Split into shapes 5 and 6, each labelled for the options it pins.
- **nit, new, in-surface:** both reworded blocks keep an absolute that the explicit verb contradicts.
  - The jsdoc says "`MetadataManager` never saves to them at runtime"; the header says the other protocols "are never saved to by the manager at runtime".
  - `MetadataManager.save()` (line 3470) saves to any loader with `save()`: a named one, one that already holds the item, or `filesystem`.
  - The claim is true of `register()`, which is what the gate is about. It predates this PR (it read "never writes"); the delta only swapped the verb.
  - Tighter wording: "`register()` never persists to them". No effect on the gate or the narrowing.
- **nit (6811661267, caller comments outside the file surface):** unchanged, still open, still outside this PR. `security-catalog-echo.ts:206` is one of them.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：元数据删除门（`unregister`、`unregisterPackage`、`bulkUnregister`）以前只对 5 类分包存储类型删掉产物门的内存副本，现在对所有类型都删。因此按包卸载、删数据源、撤回安全目录回声之后，被删的项不会再从产物门的副本里冒出来。
- 为什么改：以前一个对象、数据源或 position 被删除后，读接口仍从门的内存副本返回它，删除只删了一半（#32353）。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄（BREAKING，`@objectstack/metadata` patch）。删除后读不到该项，也不会回退到门的包体（裁定 Q1 A）；叠在它上面的定制一并删除；主机自带的、带 `delete()` 的 `memory:` loader 也会被删。第一方调用方 6 个，全部按普查核过。回滚即还原本 PR。另有一个已知的集群边界：删除只作用于执行删除的那个节点，其他节点仍回答门副本，已立卡 #32499 跟进。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `isRemovalTarget`；`metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts` 里按 7 种调用形状写的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`，预期全部通过（包级 1287/1287）。
- 需要你做的：这是 BREAKING，按规矩落地要等维护者表态；没有异议就请直接转 ready 并合并（席位的落地动作会被本会话的分类器拦下，同 #32464）。

席位意见：ACCEPT。这次收窄让 spec 本来就声明的删除语义真正生效，没有拿走任何已声明的能力。契约档复核 PASS，有一条 should-fix（两句契约注释与代码相反），已在补丁轮修好，delta 复核 PASS。

## 席位核对

1. Shape: draft PR to `main` with `Fixes #32353` as its only closing keyword. Three files: `metadata-manager.ts`, one test file and the changeset, all inside the claim's surface (`packages/metadata/src/**`). The changeset is `@objectstack/metadata` patch with the BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs: none`, one ADR-0087 `not-required` marker and the three moved answers (Q1 A included). Its sentences agree with the diff. The PR body was corrected for the patch round (7 shapes, the fixed header bullet dropped).
2. Premise measured: step 0 (`/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/32353/`) reproduced the residue through the door. The pins cover six census call shapes, plus a separate stale-slot drop shape, plus a CONTROL. Each covers the door item gone (live and on an empty-registry peer), a customization over it gone, a kept name surviving, and a re-register serving again. One ablation at the call site turned exactly 13 pins red and was restored.
3. Gates on head `9c2faf5e`: 37 check-runs `success`, 18 expected skips, 0 other. That includes Test Core, Build Core, every Type Check and Lint family, and the Dogfood Regression Gate. The dev's full local dogfood (3775 passed / 42 skipped) ran on `48eeeeac`; the delta to this head is comments plus one test shape. `mergeable_state` is `clean`; K = 8.
4. Accepted deviations: the delta review's nit ("never saves to them" is an absolute that `save()` contradicts; it predates this PR) and the caller comments outside the surface stay as they are. The attribution link points to the card thread. Contract review: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER PASS 6811661267 on `48eeeeac`, delta PASS 6811763987 on this head (claims 6811648791, 6811751693).
5. Out of scope: the cluster-peer half is filed as #32499 (the PR body's pointer #32347 is a closed PR, not a carrier). Skills-docs: none (`metadata-service.mdx` names `MemoryLoader` only as the hydrating door).
6. Landing: not governed, 180 lines ≤ 3000, Tier S on the contract-tier PASS. BREAKING, so it waits for a maintainer's word. It is held with `pm:awaiting-merge`. The landing stroke was not attempted, since the auto-mode classifier refused it on #32464.
